content.text: And, where to watch it Taylor Swift’s Best Red Carpet Looks0 seconds of 33 secondsVolume 0%Press shift question mark to access a list of keyboard shortcutsEverything you need to know on the Tristan and Khloe scandal02:0800:0000:3300:33 THE RUNDOWN The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special will be airing on Disney+ on March 24, 2026. Miley Cyrus will be interviewed by Alex Cooper for the special, along with her parents, Billy Ray Cyrus and Tish Cyrus. The special will air on Disney+ and Hulu at 3 am ET, which translates roughly to 6 pm AEDT, Australian time. The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special is almost here! While we may now remember Miley Cyrus for hits like “Wrecking Ball”, real fans will remember she got her start on the Disney Channel as Miley Stewart, a teenage girl living a double life as pop singer Hannah Montana. Related: A Short Explanation Of Miley And Billy Ray Cyrus Family Feud This mission is fraught with difficulty: as Miley Stewart tries to juggle homework and school friendships while attending glittering award ceremonies and press conferences after hours. It’s a storyline that resonated with many tween girls (and boys — Jacob Elordi recently admitted Hannah Montana was his first crush) and the series produced chart-topping hits like If We Were a Movie, I Got Nerve, and Who Said, as well as spawning two film adaptations: Hannah Montana & Miley Cyrus: Best of Both Worlds Concert (2008) and Hannah Montana: The Movie (2009). Now, we have another addition to the pantheon on our hands with Disney+’s Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special dropping on March 24. “Hannah Montana will always be a part of who I am. What started as a TV show became a shared experience that shaped my life and the lives of so many fans, and I’ll always be thankful for that connection,” Miley Cyrus said in a press release. “The fact that it still means so much to people all these yewars later is something I’m very proud of. This ‘Hannahversary’ is my way of celebrating and thanking the fans who’ve stood by me for 20 years.” If you were a “Best of Both Worlds” fan, dust off your cowboy boots because this one’s for you. What Time Does The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special Come Out In Australia?The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special will be released on Tuesday, March 24, 2026. It will drop on Disney+ in America around 3am ET, which roughly translates to 6pm AEDT. A standard Disney+ plan is $15.99 per month for ad-free viewing. What Will The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special Be About? Miley Cyrus will be adjusting her blonde wig as she returns to the Disney universe. It has been confirmed that the special will feature a sit-down with Cyrus and Hannah Montana superfan Alex Cooper (host of Call Her Daddy), a performance of "The Best of Both Worlds," and interviews with Miley's parents — country music legend Billy Ray Cyrus and mum Tish Cyrus.A lot has changed for Miley Cyrus since the 2011 Hannah Montana series finale "Wherever I Go" — she divorced her first husband, Liam Hemsworth, announced her engagement to boyfriend Maxx Morando, released nine studio albums, and cemented herself as a genuine force in pop music. Given Alex Cooper's traditionally deep-diving interview style, fans can hope for some real insight into Miley's life both in and after the series. "[The interview] will offer an intimate look at the creation of one of pop culture's most iconic characters and the lasting impact the show and character have had on fans around the world," a Disney press release read. Towards the end of the run in 2011, Miley Cyrus — who started the show when she was just 12 years old — had clearly begun to outgrow the role and, along with child stars like Sabrina Carpenter, experienced some criticism as she started to stretch her wings. Some of her work, including the music video for 2010's Can't Be Tamed, drew criticism for being inappropriate for children, and she caught flak when a video of the star smoking salvia leaked. At the time she said: “I can’t base my career off of the six-year-olds. It’s the 16-year-olds, the 26-year-olds I’m trying to reach for now. I have to move on.” While the pop star seemed eager to put Hannah Montana behind her at the time, fans will no doubt be thrilled to have her back. Ruby Feneley Senior Writer, Fashion + Beauty Ruby is a journalist and editor with a career spanning beauty, fashion, culture and lifestyle. After completing a Bachelor of Arts (English Literature/Gender and Culture Studies) at the University of Sydney, she started her Australian media career as a media and marketing reporter for Mumbrella. An ex-makeup artist, she quickly transitioned to beauty journalism and has held multiple in-house positions as a Beauty Editor. Ruby’s writing can be found across print and digital titles, including Dazed, GRAZIA, The Sydney Morning Herald, The Age, The Australian Financial Review, Refinery29 and marie claire. Now, she loves covering internet subcultures, TikTok trends and astrology (she is a Leo) as much as she loves scouring shopping aisles for the best non-sticky lip gloss and tracking down the perfect pencil for a faux freckle.
